scope: Uncommitted upstream stabilization after the authorized deletion checkpoint; qualified unpublished candidates, not a publication
review: Independent reviews reported no significant issues through this exact runtime snapshot; later changes are qualification documentation and a test-only File snapshot observation correction

gates.wasm_telemetry_clippy: cargo clippy --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --lib --features telemetry -- -D warnings: passed

runtime_evidence: Exact UTF-8/NUL/empty TEXT/BLOB/NULL values, SQLite-driven RETURNING/CTE/VALUES/PRAGMA results, affected-row/insert-ID metadata, and native SQLite readback after real browser restart
Concurrent main-thread/worker ownership, actual heartbeat/shutdown, exact namespace and retained-wrapper deletion cases
Native OPFS quota refusal, bounded rejection with original cause, immediate exclusive-handle reuse, same-runtime explicit resync without mutation replay, exact pending payload SHA after restart
Real incompatible IndexedDB request refusal and metadata unique-generation failure after valid block writes were queued; atomic rollback leaves every persisted SQLite byte unchanged
Actual owned worker termination before IndexedDB commit and after commit before response delivery, with native readback
Repeated same-WASM constructor VersionError refusals with unchanged persisted bytes, blocked upgrade cleanup, and failed SQLite-open delete/recreate
Real WAL-buffer-bound refusal rolls back and permits subsequent successful operations
Enabled telemetry success/error/sync counters, finite timing/spans, previously obtained shared-handle updates, and exact serialized HTTP bytes received by a real loopback server

resource_measurement.backends: IndexedDB and Hybrid; both package variants passed
resource_measurement.metric: WASM linear-memory allocation at operation boundaries, not RSS, JS heap, total process peak, or a supported-size ceiling
resource_measurement.byte_identity: Payload SHA and native SQLite integrity are exact; whole-file comparison explicitly normalizes the native DELETE-mode fixture to the normal WAL runtime before taking the baseline
resource_measurement.bounds: Existing export-size/WAL policies retained; checked address conversion, fallible export reservation, and short-block refusal added; OS/browser OOM termination cannot be guaranteed recoverable

conditions_and_limits: No current failing required upstream gate in the tested configuration; not a claim of all-platform or universal failure-mode qualification
One existing ignored native documentation example is disclosed, not presented as a passed test
Chromium's origin quota override did not actually refuse IndexedDB writes in the observed configuration; that is not credited as an IndexedDB quota RED
Native driver startup/shutdown contention, missing runner tools, an initial Node/browser-mode mismatch, and non-reaping-container PID exhaustion are recorded separately from product REDs
The replacement Gitless runner uses an init reaper and identical CPU/memory/PID/shared-memory limits; the complete browser gate was rerun
The WASM-only Rust BlockStorage.metrics getter returns Option<Metrics> sharing live counters instead of an unguarded Option<&Metrics>; native Rust and public JavaScript signatures remain unchanged
First prepared statement behavior remains unchanged; no implicit batch execution was added
Old deletion and diagnostic tarballs remain immutable; no new commit, push, PR, release, tag, CI dispatch, or npm publication was performed for this stabilization
Version 0.1.28 identifies unpublished evidence only; the consuming application manifest remains latest
